answer_1.quote: Historically, metrics for evaluating the quality of machine translation (MT) have relied on assessing the similarity between an MT-generated hypothesis and a human-generated reference translation in the target language.

answer_2.quote: We use the test data and setup of the WMT 2019 Metrics Shared Task in order to compare the COMET models with the top performing submissions of the shared task and other recent state-of-the-art metrics such as BERTSCORE and BLEURT.

answer_4.quote: Since 2017, the organizers of the WMT News Translation Shared Task have collected human judgements in the form of adequacy DAs. These DAs are then mapped into relative rankings (DARR).
answer_4.guideline: Direct Assessments (DA), Human-mediated Translation Edit Rate (HTER), and Multidimensional Quality Metric (MQM) framework.
